rawValueRestrictions.color: forbidden: reference color.text.* / color.surface.* / color.border.* or component tokens, never hex/rgba
rawValueRestrictions.fontSize: forbidden: use a fontSize role or typography.* role
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: forbidden: use fontFamily.* tokens only, local reference context only (commercial licensed faces)

enforced: PageSpec has no style field, so raw values cannot enter through a PageSpec (schema additionalProperties:false)
primitive/component token references must resolve (verify_all token-refs check)
convention: rawValueRestrictions apply to code generated FROM a PageSpec; they are not machine-checked on generated code by this repo
overrides: None. PageSpecs carry no per-instance token-override mechanism; styling is owned by section/component contracts.
